_comment: Dealer taunts for the POC table. Edit freely: event id -> list of lines. One is picked at random, never the same line twice in a row. Events: natural, craps, point_set, point_hit, seven_out, big_bet, low_soul, table_win, table_fail.
natural: Beginner's luck. It burns out fast.
The house lets you win. Sometimes.
craps: The dice know who they belong to.
That's the sound of my retirement.
point_set: Now you have to roll it again. Ha.
A point. Let's see you make it.
Feel the seven breathing on your neck?
point_hit: The rim was soft. I'll have it fixed.
seven_out: There it is. There it always is.
Your soul tastes like cheap whiskey.
Sevens are hot tonight. For me.
big_bet: Ooh, a high roller. I love high rollers.
All that Coin, so far from home.
Brave. Or stupid. Same thing here.
Push it all in. I dare you.
low_soul: I can see right through you now.
table_win: Get out. Before I change my mind.
Enjoy the stairs. They only go down.
table_fail: Pay the man. With your soul.
Come back when you've got more to lose.
